city.name: Cincinnati
city.regionLabel: Cincinnati, Northern Kentucky and a sensible drive

events.title: Dracula: A Comedy of Terrors
events.venue: Cincinnati Shakespeare Company, Otto M. Budig Theater
events.description: The vampire comedy adds a Bard Bash costume night: Renaissance, Shakespeare and fantasy looks are encouraged. Expect adult humor, flashing lights and loud noises.

events.title: Jack O’Lantern Glow
events.time: Timed trail entry 6:00 PM–9:45 PM; event closes 10:00 PM
events.description: Explore a half-mile illuminated pumpkin trail. Advance online tickets are separate from daytime zoo admission and membership; parking is included.

events.title: RUSH: Fifty Something Tour
events.description: Geddy Lee and Alex Lifeson bring the Fifty Something arena tour to Cincinnati. Allow extra time for riverfront parking and check the official ticket page for remaining seats.

events.title: Al Jackson
events.address: 7518 Bales Street, Space A-120, Liberty Township, OH 45069
events.description: The stand-up comic and television host takes the Liberty Center stage for two nightly sets. Seating is first come, first served, with doors opening an hour before each performance.

events.title: Debutants with Mama Said String Band and Mike Oberst
events.description: A string-band evening pairs Debutants and Louisville’s Mama Said String Band with Mike Oberst of the Tillers. The Sanctuary performance welcomes all ages.

events.title: East Walnut Hills Farmers Market
events.description: Browse produce, baked goods, prepared food and local makers at the neighborhood’s Friday market. The published October 23 lineup includes live entertainment by Nicki Sage.

events.title: Farmers Market Fresh: Autumn cooking class
events.priceLabel: Tickets $160.79–$238.53 per cooking station; solo and duo formats
events.description: Cook a seasonal meal featuring delicata squash, maple-Dijon pork tenderloin, lentils and pear cobbler. Hands-on instruction, ingredients and a meal are included; dietary needs require advance checking.

events.title: Fright Fest: Ghostbusters at Washington Park
events.age: Check film suitability for younger children
events.description: Watch the original Ghostbusters outdoors after themed lawn activities. Bring a blanket or lawn chair; snacks and drinks are sold separately.

events.title: Haunted Village at Heritage Village Museum
events.priceLabel: $15; members and ages 2 and under free; park permit extra
events.description: Meet costumed characters, trick-or-treat and explore a carnival-themed haunted house. Tickets are sold at the gate; a Great Parks vehicle permit is required.

events.title: J. Miles Wolf: Red River Gorge, a 50-year Journey
events.priceLabel: Adults $12; seniors $10; ages 3–17 $5; free with FotoFocus Biennial pass in October
events.description: Follow five decades of Wolf’s photographs of Red River Gorge, tracing changing landscapes, family memories and photographic techniques. FotoFocus passholders receive free October admission.

events.title: Mrs. Mannerly
events.description: Dale Hodges and Raymond McAnally return in Jeffrey Hatcher’s comedy about a boy and his demanding etiquette teacher in 1967 Ohio. The play runs 90 minutes without intermission.

events.title: Our Daily Bread Mural Celebration
events.venue: Our Daily Bread, rear parking lot
events.description: Meet the artists behind two new murals and celebrate Over-the-Rhine’s creative community and rescued food. Light bites are planned; the organizer provides an RSVP link.

events.title: Pumpkin Picture Show & Costume Parade
events.description: Dress up for a costume parade, Halloween short film and children’s activities. Bring seating; treats and drinks are available to buy. No pets.

events.title: The Art of Charley Harper: Creatures Wild and Tame
events.priceLabel: Adults $15 online / $17 at museum; concessions $12 online / $14; members and ages 5 and under free
events.description: Explore more than 140 drawings, paintings, collages and wildlife posters in this new survey of Harper’s colorful “minimal realism.” A separate exhibition ticket is required.

events.title: Tiny Dusk Concerts: Billy Fortune Unit
events.description: Catch Billy Fortune Unit at the free rooftop music series. Rooftop operations depend on weather, so check the brewery’s latest updates before going.

events.title: Yellow Brick Joel: The Tribute Concert
events.description: David Clark and Bill Connors celebrate the piano-led songs of Billy Joel and Elton John. An all-ages tribute show in the intimate Clifton venue.

events.title: Cincinnati Bearcats vs. Texas Tech: Homecoming
events.address: Nippert Stadium, University of Cincinnati campus, Cincinnati, OH
events.description: The Bearcats host Texas Tech for Cincinnati’s 100th Homecoming. The official athletics schedule calls for fans to wear red; check tickets and campus parking before making plans.

events.title: Cyclones vs. Bloomington Bison: First Face-Off
events.description: Welcome hockey back with the Cyclones’ First Face-Off game against Bloomington. The arena advertises $2 hot dogs, sodas and beers; admission is separate.

events.title: HallZOOween
events.priceLabel: Included with zoo admission or membership; Check source for admission price
events.description: Bring a treat bag for daytime trick-or-treat stations, animal pumpkin enrichment and costume fun. The Costume Cavalcade starts at noon.

events.title: Nature at Night Pumpkin Hike
events.time: 6:30 PM–8:30 PM; timed entry at 6:30, 6:45 or 7:00 PM
events.priceLabel: $7 per person; $13 with pumpkin drawing; park permit required
events.description: Follow glowing pumpkins on a self-guided evening hike, then warm up by the fire. Bring a flashlight and reserve a timed-entry ticket.

events.title: WestSide Market: Halloween Edition
events.description: Shop local small businesses and makers at Westwood Town Hall, with trick-or-treating and costumes adding a seasonal twist to the market.

events.title: Al Jackson
events.address: 7518 Bales Street, Space A-120, Liberty Township, OH 45069
events.description: The stand-up comic and television host takes the Liberty Center stage for two nightly sets. Seating is first come, first served, with doors opening an hour before each performance.

events.title: Cincinnati Coffee Festival
events.time: Timed entry 8:00 AM–3:00 PM; festival closes 4:00 PM
events.priceLabel: Advance tickets $15–$30 by entry time; day-of $19–$37; fees included
events.description: Sample coffee, tea and chocolate, watch demonstrations and browse vendors. Select a timed-entry ticket; Saturday 9 AM and 10 AM entries were sold out when checked.
events.sourceName: Cincinnati Arts Association / Ohio River Foundation

events.title: Dracula: A Comedy of Terrors
events.venue: Cincinnati Shakespeare Company, Otto M. Budig Theater
events.description: A comic reinvention of the Dracula story brings adult humor and gothic mischief to the stage. The production includes flashing lights and loud noises.

events.title: Ellis Paul with Alice Peacock
events.venue: The Southgate House Revival, Revival Room
events.description: Singer-songwriters Ellis Paul and Alice Peacock share an intimate Newport bill. This is a fully seated show for guests ages 18 and older.

events.title: Fall Fest at Washington Park
events.priceLabel: Free admission and core activities; shopping, food and some crafts extra
events.description: Enjoy a free pumpkin patch, petting zoo, trackless train and live music. Browse local vendors; some crafts, shopping and food cost extra.

events.title: Fall on the Farm at Blooms & Berries
events.description: Spend a fall day with hayrides, a corn maze, farm animals and play attractions. Buy tickets online in advance; weekend gate sales are not guaranteed.

events.title: Fright Fest: Beetlejuice at Ziegler Park
events.age: Check film suitability for younger children
events.description: Catch the 1988 Beetlejuice outdoors and dress up for the costume contest. Bring your own seating for the park screening.

events.title: Haunted Village at Heritage Village Museum
events.priceLabel: $15; members and ages 2 and under free; park permit extra
events.description: Meet costumed characters, trick-or-treat and explore a carnival-themed haunted house. Tickets are sold at the gate; a Great Parks vehicle permit is required.

events.title: Jack O’Lantern Glow
events.time: Timed trail entry 6:00 PM–9:45 PM; event closes 10:00 PM
events.description: Explore a half-mile illuminated pumpkin trail. Advance online tickets are separate from daytime zoo admission and membership; parking is included.

events.title: Mrs. Mannerly
events.description: Dale Hodges and Raymond McAnally return in Jeffrey Hatcher’s comedy about a boy and his demanding etiquette teacher in 1967 Ohio. The play runs 90 minutes without intermission.

events.title: Nancy Rexroth: Secrets of My Power
events.description: A free FotoFocus retrospective brings together more than 150 photographs, personal objects and rarely seen works by the experimental photographer behind IOWA.

events.title: Pink Talking Fish
events.priceLabel: $25 advance / $30 day of show; check checkout total
events.description: This tribute-fusion band connects the music of Pink Floyd, Talking Heads and Phish in one jam-filled performance. The venue lists this as a general-admission show.

events.title: Pumpkin Patch at Winton Woods Farm
events.priceLabel: Pie pumpkin $4; large pumpkin $7; park permit required
events.description: Pick a pumpkin and enjoy decorating, crafts and games. Storytime is at 11 AM and 1 PM, with critter encounters a half-hour later.

events.title: soHza sister Boutique Grand Opening
events.description: Celebrate the fair-trade boutique’s new permanent Findlay Market storefront with live music and special activities. Browse jewelry, bags and clothing made by women’s groups.

events.title: The Art on the Change of Life Tour
events.description: A guided art discussion explores women in midlife, identity and menopause through selected works in the museum. Free advance registration is required.

events.title: Zach Williams: Revival Nights
events.description: Zach Williams brings his country, rock and gospel sound to the Taft with Cochren & Co. and Christian Hohn. Check the venue’s clear-bag policy before heading downtown.

events.title: Cincinnati Coffee Festival
events.time: Timed entry 8:00 AM–3:00 PM; festival closes 4:00 PM
events.priceLabel: Advance tickets $15–$30 by entry time; day-of $19–$37; fees included
events.description: Taste coffee, tea and chocolate and explore vendor booths and demonstrations. Tickets are tied to an entry time, after which visitors may stay until closing.
events.sourceName: Cincinnati Arts Association / Ohio River Foundation

events.title: Edie McKee Harper: Modernist at Play
events.description: Discover the Cincinnati artist’s playful modernism through more than 100 photographs, paintings, enamels, weavings, illustrations and prints. Sunday general admission is free.

events.title: Country Pumpkins Fall Festival
events.address: 1835 Sherman Mt. Zion Road, Dry Ridge, KY 41035
events.priceLabel: Pumpkin Ridge $10; weekend Fun Pass $23 on-site; pumpkins extra
events.description: Choose farm play, a corn maze or weekend rides in Northern Kentucky. Friday rides start at 5 PM; pumpkins are separate from the Fun Pass.

events.title: David Faul: album-release show
events.venue: The Southgate House Revival, Revival Room
events.description: The Cincinnati songwriter brings personal, roots-oriented songs to the Revival Room. An early Sunday show that leaves room for dinner afterward.

events.title: Dracula: A Comedy of Terrors
events.venue: Cincinnati Shakespeare Company, Otto M. Budig Theater
events.description: A Sunday matinee of the playful vampire comedy includes a post-show cast Q&A. The production contains adult humor, flashing lights and loud noises.

events.title: Fall Fest at Washington Park
events.priceLabel: Free admission and core activities; shopping, food and some crafts extra
events.description: Enjoy a free pumpkin patch, petting zoo, trackless train and live music. Browse local vendors; some crafts, shopping and food cost extra.

events.title: Fiona Cauley
events.address: 7518 Bales Street, Space A-120, Liberty Township, OH 45069
events.description: Fiona Cauley brings her quick wit and dark humor to Liberty Center. Seating is first come, first served, and the club requires valid identification for entry.

events.title: Fright Fest: family double feature at Imagination Alley
events.description: Pair pumpkin painting with It’s the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown and Hotel Transylvania. Bring a blanket or lawn chair for the outdoor double feature.

events.title: HallZOOween
events.priceLabel: Included with zoo admission or membership; Check source for admission price
events.description: Bring a treat bag for daytime trick-or-treat stations, animal pumpkin enrichment and costume fun. The Costume Cavalcade starts at noon.

events.title: Jack O’Lantern Glow
events.time: Timed trail entry 6:00 PM–9:45 PM; event closes 10:00 PM
events.description: Explore a half-mile illuminated pumpkin trail. Advance online tickets are separate from daytime zoo admission and membership; parking is included.

events.title: Mrs. Mannerly
events.description: Catch the Sunday matinee of Jeffrey Hatcher’s comedy about childhood etiquette lessons. A 1 PM pre-show conversation considers what good manners mean today; the play begins at 2 PM.

events.title: Ohio Renaissance Festival: Myths & Monsters Weekend
events.priceLabel: Adult October admission $39 + fees; Check source for child pricing
events.description: Explore a Renaissance village filled with folklore characters and fantastical costumes. Sunday tickets were limited at verification; Saturday is sold out. Buy before driving.

events.title: The Fab Four: A Hard Day’s Night
events.description: The Beatles tribute group performs music from A Hard Day’s Night and favorites from across the band’s career. A Sunday-evening option at the historic Taft Theatre.

events.title: The Music of the Beach Boys: Pet Sounds Live
events.description: Hear the Pet Sounds album performed in full alongside other Beach Boys favorites, with narration and multimedia. This is the rescheduled performance; check the ticket source if holding an earlier booking.

events.title: The Teachers Lounge
events.address: 7518 Bales Street, Space A-120, Liberty Township, OH 45069
events.description: Andrea Forcum, Philip Lindsay and Gaspare Randazzo share classroom stories and the absurd side of teaching. A Sunday-afternoon comedy show for adult audiences.
